name: Azerbaijan
tagline: Medieval walls, flame-lit towers, and a hillside that never stops burning
hero_description: Baku stacks a UNESCO-listed medieval Old City against a skyline of flame-shaped towers that ripple with fire animations after dark — and that's before the day trips get strange, in the best way: 40,000-year-old rock carvings at Gobustan, bubbling mud volcanoes, and Yanar Dag, a natural-gas hillside that has burned for decades. A three-day e-visa and short flights make it one of the easiest 'Europe-feel' breaks from India.
best_time_to_visit: April to June and September to October — comfortable 15–25°C for boulevard walks and day trips; high summer pushes past 30°C and winter earns Baku its 'city of winds' name.

top_attractions.name: Icherisheher — Baku's Old City
top_attractions.description: The UNESCO-listed walled core of Baku, holding the enigmatic 12th-century Maiden Tower and the 15th-century Palace of the Shirvanshahs within its lanes.

top_attractions.name: Flame Towers
top_attractions.description: Three flame-shaped towers rising to 182 m above the bay — after dark their LED facades turn into rippling fire, best watched from the Highland Park funicular viewpoint.

top_attractions.name: Gobustan National Park
top_attractions.description: A UNESCO site about 65 km from Baku with roughly 6,000 petroglyphs — hunting scenes and reed boats carved up to 40,000 years ago.

top_attractions.name: The mud volcanoes
top_attractions.description: Azerbaijan holds nearly half the world's mud volcanoes — fields of cold grey cones near Gobustan that gurgle and spit like a lunar landscape with a pulse.

top_attractions.name: Yanar Dag
top_attractions.description: The 'Burning Mountain' of the Absheron Peninsula — a natural-gas seep that has kept a wall of flame alight continuously for decades, rain or snow.

top_attractions.name: Ateshgah Fire Temple
top_attractions.description: A 17th–18th-century fire temple at Surakhani carrying inscriptions from Indian merchant devotees — a genuine historical thread between Baku and India.
